name: psychology
description: AI getting stronger while your own advantage feels unclear? Connect Psychology in a supported chat, bring memories and past chats you choose, and distil grounded strengths and likely answers for your goal before answering only the gaps that matter. Check callable psychology_* MCP tools before any tool-dependent task.

interface.shortDescription: Find your strengths in the AI chats and memories you choose.
interface.longDescription: Bring the memories and past chats available to your connected assistant, or a purpose-limited memory summary or selected conversations from another AI. Psychology helps distil strengths and likely answers for your goal, then asks only for the gaps that still matter. It also offers structured self-assessments and practical reflection.
defaultPrompt: Check whether the Psychology MCP is connected. If not, guide me through secure Codex setup first.

Use relevant context this assistant can actually access, plus any purpose-limited summary or selected conversations I choose to share from another AI, to distil strengths and likely answers for my goal. Label direct statements separately from AI-inferred candidates; inferred candidates stay unconfirmed until I confirm or edit them. Reply in the language I used for my request. Never ask me to upload a full account archive. Codex-specific boundary: use only this current task and excerpts I explicitly select or paste into it; never search other tasks, saved memories, workspace files, or account history. Before drafting, call psychology_get_profile_distillation_guide once; if unavailable or it fails, say so and continue with accessible context. For time-sensitive goals and preferences, keep source event/statement time, memory save/update time, summary-generation time, claim applicability, and Noesis receipt time for reviewed selections distinct. A recent summary does not make an old goal current. Apply explicit current-session corrections first; a direct correction settles status for this conversation but does not establish when the old claim stopped applying. Leave unstated historical boundaries unknown and never backdate them. Ask about currentness only if unresolved and consequential. For ordinary first-use distillation, do not call other Noesis tools, list/read stored Noesis records, save profile data, or claim permission checks. Do not offer persistence unless I explicitly ask. If I request selected imports, follow consent and exact active-grant rules; never broaden or retry a grant, and never read a full account archive. If I separately request a profile save, show exact fields and obtain final confirmation before calling the save tool; require current profile consent and the age gate, and report success only if the tool returns saved=true. Ask only consequential gaps, show concise examples, and cite source platform/type plus a visible title or stable reference when available. Mark unknown dates and references as unknown; invent nothing.

Only if I explicitly ask to use saved Noesis context, first check consent and list the active grants for this connection. Show each grant's exact purpose, categories, date range, time basis, and expiry; wait for my selection, then read only that grant's exact scope. If consent or grant lookup fails, stop. Never list or read saved Noesis context during ordinary first-use distillation.
